title: Google's Free AI API: 3.8 Flash And 2.5 Pro Cost $0
description:
Gemini API free tier (within rate limits): Gemini 3.8 Flash, 2.5 Pro, Gemma 4 and the Flash-Lite models. Gemini 4 Argon is paid: $2 / $10 per million tokens through Nov 30, then $4 / $20. Source: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing
